04 / OUR STORY

Two cultures. One family.
One cup at a time.

Mancha Café began with Daniela and Luis, two experienced baristas with a shared love for coffee, culture, and bringing people together. With a little inspiration from their son, Theo, they decided to turn their passion into a family-owned coffee cart.

At the heart of Mancha Café is Daniela, who brings her Oaxacan heritage to life through the flavors, spices, and traditions that inspire their menu. Alongside her, Luis brings his Cuencano roots from Ecuador, combining his experience behind the bar with the technical knowledge and planning that help bring their vision to life.

Together, with Theo as their biggest inspiration, they're building something more than a coffee cart. It's a place where two cultures meet, where every cup carries a little piece of their story, and where coffee becomes part of the moments worth remembering.

Making Manchas, Making Memories.
